# python

> Use when writing or reviewing Python — type hints and strict typing, error handling (specific exceptions, no bare except), mutable default arguments, dataclasses vs dicts, context managers for resources, iterator/comprehension choices, and async pitfalls (blocking calls in async, sync/async boundaries). Trigger on `.py` / `pyproject.toml` work even when "Python" is not named. This is a language-idioms skill, not a project bootstrap — for package/venv scaffolding, ordinary docs suffice.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install HukuKaich0u/agent-kit/skills/lang/python
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml
dependencies:
  apm:
    - HukuKaich0u/agent-kit/skills/lang/python
```

then run `apm install`.

### Any agentskills.io-compatible agent

This is an [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) skill — a portable
`SKILL.md` folder that works with Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI,
Cursor, and other [compatible agents](https://agentskills.io/clients).

With the [`skills`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) CLI (installs into
every detected agent's skills directory):

```bash
npx skills add HukuKaich0u/agent-kit --skill python
```

Or copy the folder in directly:

```bash
npx degit HukuKaich0u/agent-kit/skills/lang/python ~/.claude/skills/python
```

See [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) for what this skill does and when to use it.
